title: The Leeward Trail
premise: Zephyrine Reyes, a salvage diver hiding from a past that drowned a man in Puerto Rico, works the Leeward Shoals where a navy-sealed wreck hums with secrets no one will name. When dying prospector Augustin Vex trades him a hand-drawn map to a second, deeper wreck for a promise to bury his bones on land, Zephyrine inherits both a treasure and a target: the map is half of one, and the salvage fleet holds the other half. Racing six tides before the dry season closes the shoals, he must decide whether the identity he buried can stay dead when survival demands he surface it. In the end, Zephyrine reaches the wreck first but chooses to scuttle its cargo manifest—buying his freedom by letting the truth sink—and buries Vex as promised, finally measuring life in years again.
about_author: Rosalind Brightwater spent a decade crewing research vessels out of Bridgetown before turning to fiction, and her prose carries the salt-rot smell of real deck work. She writes from a stilt house on Carriacou, where she keeps her late father's diving logs and an unhealthy collection of tide tables.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Working the navy-sealed wreck at Leeward Shoals, he counts tides like other men count birthdays, establishing his exile-by-choice and the dry-season deadline. He recovers a corroded locker stamped with a name he recognizes—and lies about it to his partner Delphine. Emotional beat: the numb discipline of a man who has made invisibility a craft.

chapters.title: The Prospector's Bargain
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. On shore at Port Anse, he finds Augustin Vex dying in a flophouse, clutching a wax-cloth map to a second wreck deeper in the shoals. Vex offers it free—for a promise: carry his ashes to the hill cemetery at Sainte-Rose. Zephyrine, who breaks promises professionally, hears himself say yes. Emotional beat: guilt arriving uninvited.

chapters.title: Half a Map
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Studying the map by lamplight, he realizes its bearings only resolve against a second chart—the fleet's master survey, held aboard the salvage tender Cormorant. The navy's interest in the first wreck suddenly makes sense: they're looking for this one too. Emotional beat: the trap of wanting something after three years of wanting nothing.

chapters.title: Delphine Counts the Days
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. She has watched Zephyrine measure miles instead of years and knows a man planning something desperate when she sees one. She confronts him; he deflects; she reveals she once dove the sealed wreck illegally and saw bodies that weren't storm victims. Emotional beat: loyalty strained between partners who trust each other with everything except the past.

chapters.title: The Cormorant
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Posing as a contract diver, he boards the salvage tender and memorizes the survey room layout—but the fleet's director, Ivo Marchetti, recognizes his face from a ten-year-old incident report. Zephyrine escapes the ship knowing Marchetti knows, which means the race has already started. Emotional beat: cold fear sharpening into focus.

chapters.title: What Drowned at Mayagüez
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter, Zephyrine's POV. Ten years earlier: the diving accident off Puerto Rico, the partner who died because Zephyrine falsified a depth log to protect his own record, the inquiry, the flight south. The chapter explains why he measures life in miles and why Marchetti's file terrifies him. Emotional beat: shame as ballast he cannot cut loose.

chapters.title: Borrowed Boat
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. He trades his salvage gear to a smuggler named Teo for a fast, unregistered skiff and a week of silence. Teo warns him the fleet has posted a quiet bounty on any diver asking about the deep shoal. First blood of the race: another prospector who'd seen Vex's map turns up drowned. Emotional beat: the price of survival ticking upward.

chapters.title: Ashes in a Coffee Tin
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Waiting out a squall, he reads Vex's letters to a daughter in Sainte-Rose and understands the promise isn't about geography—it's about a man who wanted to be claimed by somewhere. Zephyrine, who has spent a decade refusing to be claimed by anything, feels the map pulling two directions. Emotional beat: tenderness he resents feeling.

chapters.title: Marchetti's Offer
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Marchetti intercepts him at anchor and offers partnership: dive the wreck together, split the cargo, and the Mayagüez file disappears. All Zephyrine must do is surrender the map. Refusing means the fleet hunts him openly. He refuses, and swims back to his skiff through water lit by searchlights. Emotional beat: defiance that feels almost like coming home.

chapters.title: The Deep Shoal
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Using Vex's bearings and dead reckoning, he locates the second wreck—a colonial-era slaver whose hold holds more than coin: sealed manifests naming families, records someone powerful paid to keep lost. He surfaces with one bronze manifest case just as the Cormorant rounds the point. Emotional beat: awe curdling into dread.

chapters.title: Delphine Decides
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. She finds Zephyrine's camp ransacked, the map gone, blood on the coral. Choosing between safety and him, she takes her own boat out into the fleet's traffic, running decoy lights to buy him hours. Emotional beat: love expressed as navigation—choosing a heading that might kill her.

chapters.title: Interrogation by Tide
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Captured briefly by Marchetti's enforcers, he talks his way loose by feeding them false coordinates—sacrificing hours of his lead. They take the bronze case anyway. He escapes with nothing but Vex's promise and a head start measured in one tide. Emotional beat: rage transmuted into cold arithmetic.

chapters.title: Sainte-Rose Hill
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. A detour he cannot afford: he delivers Vex's ashes to the hillside cemetery and meets Vex's daughter, Colette, who gives him the missing half of the story—and a duplicate page of the map Vex mailed home years ago. Emotional beat: grief shared is grief halved; the promise kept becomes fuel.

chapters.title: Two Tides Left
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. With the duplicate page and Delphine's decoy run, he re-plots the true site of the manifest hold—the first wreck was the decoy all along; the navy sealed the wrong ship. The dry season front builds on the horizon. Emotional beat: hope so sharp it hurts.

chapters.title: The Navy's Silence
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. He dives the correctly-plotted hold and finds the full archive—including proof that a government minister's fortune was built on the slave trade and laundered through the salvage fleet itself. Marchetti isn't hunting treasure; he's hunting evidence. Emotional beat: understanding that the prize was never gold.

chapters.title: Cut Loose
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. Her decoy gambit fails; she's taken aboard the Cormorant and interrogated. She gives up nothing but buys time by pretending to negotiate. Through a porthole she watches Zephyrine's skiff ghost past the fleet anchorage at dusk. Emotional beat: terror braided with fierce pride.

chapters.title: One Tide
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. The final tide before the dry season closes the shoals. He must choose: dive for the captain's strongbox (wealth enough to vanish forever) or the evidence locker (truth that will burn him too). Marchetti's boats close in behind him. Emotional beat: the eye of the storm—stillness before the decision.

chapters.title: The Long Dive
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Climax begins: he dives past safe limits into the flooded hold while Marchetti's divers descend on lines above him. In the dark he confronts the phantom of his drowned partner, and for the first time speaks the truth of Mayagüez aloud into his mask. Emotional beat: confession as decompression—the past surfacing or killing him.

chapters.title: Scuttled
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Climax resolves: he takes the evidence, floods the strongbox chamber, and lets the fleet's own charges—meant to seal the wreck—collapse the passage behind him. He surfaces inside Delphine's stolen launch as the Cormorant's divers find only rubble. Marchetti's leverage dies with the wreck. Emotional beat: liberation through loss.

chapters.title: The Manifest Goes Ashore
chapters.summary: Zephyrine and Delphine's alternating POV. They deliver copies of the manifest to a journalist in Fort-de-France and disappear before dawn. The minister falls; Marchetti, stripped of protection, flees. Zephyrine learns the file on Mayagüez has been quietly closed—not forgiven, but no longer a leash. Emotional beat: justice that costs exactly what it should.

chapters.title: Miles Into Years
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. He returns to Leeward Shoals one last time, not to dive but to look, and leaves Vex's compass on the reef above the scuttled hold. Delphine asks what he'll measure now. He says he hasn't decided yet, and for the first time the not-knowing feels like freedom rather than exile. Emotional beat: quiet arrival.

chapters.title: Sainte-Rose, Dry Season's End
chapters.summary: Colette's POV, closing frame. Months later, a letter arrives at Sainte-Rose from a man signing himself only 'the diver,' enclosing money for the cemetery wall's repair and a pressed flower from the hill. Colette smiles, understanding her father kept his promise through someone else's hands. Emotional beat: memory as inheritance—the trail continues without him.
